shortDescription: Strategy and Strive added a combined 2,305 Bitcoin this week, bringing their holdings to 846,000 and 26,355 BTC, respectively. According to Odaily, all listed companies together hold 1.273 million BTC, with Strategy ranking first among public companies and Strive entering the top five.
